# Requirements Quality Checklist: Baseline company knowledge agent (001)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the written requirements of feature 001 (spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md) across security/authentication, grounding and agent bounds, ingestion, persistence, deployment and UI accessibility.
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Run parameters (non-interactive, conservative defaults)**: depth Standard; audience
PR reviewer; focus areas as requested by the reviewer (security/auth, grounding and
agent bounds, ingestion, persistence, deployment/UI accessibility). The file is named
`requirements-quality.md` instead of `requirements.md` because `/speckit-checklist`
reserves `checklists/requirements.md` for the built-in spec-quality lifecycle of
`/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`. The reviewer explicitly asked the agent to
evaluate the items: each marker below records that evaluation on 2026-10-07 against
spec.md (including its 2026-10-07 Clarifications), plan.md, tasks.md, the canonical
contract `docs/API_CONTRACT.md` named by plan.md, and the code used only to confirm
what the requirements say. Unchecked items are requirement-writing gaps, not
implementation defects.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the roles (public visitor, customer, administrator, operator) and the operations reserved to each documented? [Completeness, Spec §User stories 2/5/6/9, Spec §Clarifications] — Clarification Q1 and the new acceptance bullet enumerate the administrator-only operations and the 404 for another account's conversation.
- [x] CHK002 Are session lifetime, refresh rotation, revocation and sign-in throttling requirements specified? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Q2, Spec §FR-008] — 30 min access, 7-day rotated refresh, family revocation, 10 attempts / 5 min.
- [x] CHK003 Are the supported ingestion formats and their size limits enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §Acceptance criteria, Spec §Clarifications Q4] — previously only "supported ingestion"; now TXT/MD/PDF/DOCX/JSON/CSV/ZIP with numeric limits.
- [x] CHK004 Is the lifecycle of a business request (states, transitions, actor allowed to change them, inbox size) defined? [Gap, Spec §User story 6, Spec §FR-010] — Spec only says "confirmed requests/admin inbox". The contract shows a single `received` status, idempotency per user and action key and no administrator transition; the spec does not state that the inbox is read-only or bounded (latest 50; latest 20 per customer). Deferred from clarify (question quota). **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md acceptance criteria now state confirmation per user and action key, the single `received` status, no external delivery and the 20/50 list bounds; Scope limits excludes status workflows.
- [x] CHK005 Are data retention and deletion requirements defined for conversations, documents and accounts? [Gap, Spec §User story 5, Spec §FR-002] — Owner-only conversation deletion and document deletion exist in the canonical contract but not in spec.md; account deletion and password reset are neither specified nor listed in Scope limits. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md now states own-conversation and document deletion (chunks and vectors) and excludes account deletion from scope.
- [x] CHK006 Are the MCP surface and its authentication requirements complete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Acceptance criteria] — read-only, through the API, no second Qdrant writer, protected search requires authentication; details in the canonical contract.
- [x] CHK007 Are the terminal sandbox presets and their numeric limits (timeout, output size, resources) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §IV] — Spec requires "fixed presets in the separate nonroot container" but does not name the presets or quantify their limits, although the constitution requires hard bounds. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md sandbox bullet names the five presets and quantifies time, CPU, memory, output, writes and concurrency, plus calculator bounds.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "bounded" quantified for agent iterations, tool calls, output tokens, provider timeout and concurrency? [Clarity, Spec §Acceptance criteria, Spec §Clarifications Q3]
- [x] CHK009 Is "grounded answer" defined by an objective rule and is the explicit uncertainty statement specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Clarifications Q5] — valid `[S#]` citation to a source retrieved in the same turn; otherwise tool-derived text or the no-evidence statement.
- [x] CHK010 Is demo-mode activation unambiguous, including whether a failed live request may fall back to demo? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Clarifications Q5]
- [x] CHK011 Is "paginated" customer listing quantified (page bounds, ordering, out-of-range pages)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Contracts → docs/API_CONTRACT.md] — limit 1–100 (default 25), creation-time descending, empty page past the end, same snapshot.
- [x] CHK012 Are "verified TLS" and "dedicated schema" defined with checkable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, docs/API_CONTRACT.md] — `sslmode=verify-full` outside loopback, only `sslmode`/`sslrootcert` accepted, dedicated non-`public` schema.
- [x] CHK013 Is the "protected origin" between the Vercel proxy and the VPS defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Stack, docs/API_CONTRACT.md] — server-side origin secret, separate from API authentication, never sent to browsers.
- [x] CHK014 Are "user", "visitor", "customer" and "candidate" given distinct, consistently used meanings? [Ambiguity, Spec §User stories 1/3/8/10] — Stories 1 and 3 say "user" for an authenticated account, stories 8 and 10 say "visitors"; no glossary states that chat requires an account when authentication is enabled. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md now defines visitor, user, customer, administrator, operator and candidate.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Are FR-003 and FR-009 consistent about who supplies the Anthropic key? [Conflict, Spec §Traceability FR-003/FR-009] — FR-003 says each installation needs its own backend key, while FR-009 says live calls "require a user's key", which can be read as a per-customer key and contradicts backend-only configuration. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: FR-009 evidence now reads "the operator's backend key".
- [x] CHK016 Do the paths named in tasks.md and plan.md describe the current module layout after the domain refactor? [Consistency, Tasks T009/T020/T021] — All named paths exist, but T009 points to `backend/app/main.py` (routes now in `backend/app/api/routes/`), T020 to the `scripts/import-material.py` wrapper (logic in `scripts/material_import/`) and T021 to `backend/app/mcp/server.py` (session flow in `backend/app/mcp/sessions.py` and `client.py`). **Remediated 2026-10-07**: T002, T009, T016, T020 and T021 now name their current module paths.
- [x] CHK017 Are the SSE event names and error codes consistent between plan.md, the canonical contract and the implemented behavior they promise? [Consistency, Plan §Contracts, docs/API_CONTRACT.md] — Event names match; the contract's error-code list omits `empty_response` and the generic `internal_error`. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: docs/API_CONTRACT.md now lists `empty_response` and `internal_error` and the JSON status codes.
- [x] CHK018 Is the role model consistent between "customers can search" (story 2) and the administrator-only reader, upload and tool playground? [Consistency, Spec §User story 2, Spec §Clarifications Q1]
- [x] CHK019 Are SQLite and PostgreSQL held to the same authentication and business contracts? [Consistency, Spec §User story 7, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK020 Is the single-API-worker constraint consistent with process-local bounds (sign-in throttling, chat slots, conversation locks, local Qdrant)? [Consistency, Constitution §Security and workflow, Plan §Stack, Spec §Clarifications Q2/Q3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Does every FR-001…FR-014 row name objective acceptance evidence? [Measurability, Spec §Requirement traceability]
- [x] CHK022 Is every FR traced to at least one task? [Traceability, Tasks] — FR-001 T001/T019 · FR-002 T001/T016/T020/T022 · FR-003 T002/T019 · FR-004 T002 · FR-005 T004 · FR-006 T002/T021 · FR-007 T004/T005/T018/T020/T023/T025 · FR-008 T008/T016/T021/T024 · FR-009 T009 · FR-010 T003/T007/T010/T023 · FR-011 T011 · FR-012 T012/T026 · FR-013 T013/T015 · FR-014 T014/T016/T017/T023/T024/T025.
- [x] CHK023 Are UI accessibility criteria measurable (minimum text size, contrast ratio, viewport widths, keyboard operation, single completion announcement)? [Measurability, Spec §Acceptance criteria, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK024 Is "strict types and checks" tied to named, repeatable gates? [Measurability, Spec §Acceptance criteria, Plan §Verification] — plan lists typecheck, lint, build and test families; Makefile/`scripts/check.sh` provide the commands.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are exception flows defined for provider failure, refusal, output limit and tool/iteration budget exhaustion? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Clarifications Q5]
- [x] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined for transient session-refresh failures in the browser? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-008] — T024 implemented "preserve the session on transient refresh errors", but no spec requirement states the expected behavior. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md now states that only a 401/403 refresh ends the browser session.
- [x] CHK027 Are concurrency scenarios covered (simultaneous chats, concurrent registrations during pagination, repeated confirmations)? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications Q3, Spec §FR-010/FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 Are empty, loading and error states specified for the chat, documents, requests and customers views? [Gap, UX] — Not present in spec.md or plan.md.
- [x] CHK029 Are persistence-after-restart requirements defined for documents, vectors, sessions and histories? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Are archive and file edge cases specified (traversal, symlinks, encrypted entries, compression bombs, unsupported, unreadable, empty or credential-bearing files)? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications Q4, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK031 Is the behavior defined when an optional service (sandbox, MCP) is disabled or unreachable? [Gap, Spec §User story 3] — Story 3 limits demonstrations to enabled services but does not say whether disabled tools are hidden from the model and catalog or how an unreachable sandbox is reported. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: spec.md now states that disabled tools are not offered and an unreachable sandbox is a failed tool call.
- [ ] CHK032 Is the expected handling of a reused (already rotated) refresh token specified? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Clarifications Q2] — Rotation and family revocation on logout are specified; reuse of a superseded token is neither required to revoke the family nor explicitly accepted as a risk.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Are latency or throughput targets specified (first token, full answer, ingestion)? [Gap, Performance] — None; the spec neither sets targets nor declares them out of scope for the baseline. **Remediated 2026-10-07**: Scope limits now declares latency/throughput targets outside the baseline.
- [ ] CHK034 Are logging requirements specified (what is logged and what must never be logged)? [Gap, Observability, Constitution §V] — Only the canonical contract states that provider failures log type, status and request id; spec.md is silent.
- [x] CHK035 Are secret-handling requirements stated for the browser, HTTP routes and public responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Acceptance criteria]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Are external dependencies and their unavailable-state behavior documented (Anthropic, PostgreSQL, remote Qdrant, Vercel, VPS)? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003/FR-011/FR-012] — Anthropic is covered by Clarification Q5; storage unavailability (503) and remote Qdrant (untested per tasks.md) have no requirement.
- [ ] CHK037 Is the model download required by semantic embeddings disclosed in the requirement artifacts? [Assumption, Plan §Stack] — Disclosed in README.md and config/env.example, not in spec.md or plan.md.
- [x] CHK038 Are the prerequisites of pending tasks (authenticated SSH, operator-held secrets) recorded as explicit assumptions? [Assumption, Tasks T015/T017/T026/T018]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK039 Does the requirement set distinguish production evidence from local evidence? [Traceability, Spec §Requirement traceability, Tasks] — FR-013 tracks the production rollout separately; T015/T017/T026 remain open.
- [x] CHK040 Does Scope limits explicitly exclude account self-service features a reader may assume (password reset, e-mail verification, account deletion)? [Gap, Spec §Scope limits] **Remediated 2026-10-07**: Scope limits now excludes password reset, e-mail verification and account deletion.
